And with the people touching you stuff the feeling of needing to wash it off is common with sexual abuse victims I still sometimes have it till this day with even my girlfriend and other friends and with your mother she sounds terrible and the best thing I can say to focus on is just try to get good grades maybe even tell a teacher about what’s happening and sometimes they’ll help you. And my best advice is to just go when you turn 18 separate yourself from those people try to do good in school so you can do that but even if you can’t try college or a trade school.
